import pandas as pd
import re

ben_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'
pay_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'

ben = pd.read_csv(ben_path)
pay = pd.read_excel(pay_path, sheet_name='Disbursements', header=4)
pay.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in pay.columns]
pay = pay.dropna(subset=['Payment ID'])

# Clean Beneficiary ID
pay['Beneficiary ID'] = pay['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Clean Status
pay['Status_clean'] = pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

# Filter paid
pay_paid = pay[pay['Status_clean'] == 'paid'].copy()

# Filter beneficiary exists
ben_ids = set(ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip())
pay_filtered = pay_paid[pay_paid['Beneficiary ID'].isin(ben_ids)].copy()

# Clean Amount
def clean_amount(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None
    s = str(x)
    # remove ₹, commas, spaces
    s = s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # keep digits and dot
    # also handle possible non-breaking spaces
    s = re.sub(r'[^\d\.]', '', s)
    try:
        return float(s) if s else None
    except:
        return None

pay_filtered['Amount_clean'] = pay_filtered['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_amount)

# Merge
merged = pay_filtered.merge(ben, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')

# Filter programme and state
mask = (merged['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip() == "Girls' Education") & (merged['State'].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Odisha')
filtered = merged[mask]
total = filtered['Amount_clean'].sum(skipna=True)
print('filtered rows', len(filtered))
print('non-null amounts', filtered['Amount_clean'].notna().sum())
print('total', total)
# Check any remaining NaNs
nan_rows = filtered[filtered['Amount_clean'].isna()]
print('nan rows count', len(nan_rows))
if len(nan_rows)>0:
    print(nan_rows[['Payment ID','Beneficiary ID','Amount (INR)']].head())
